I have six hectares in total, but this plot is just a small garden near the house, only 0.08 hectares. I plant my food crops here, mixed together. I will not put chemical fertilizer on this plot because one bag is too expensive for such a small piece of land, and I need to save what I buy for my bigger fields. But I will put manure on it because I have cows and the soil in Mtwara is sandy. I will use the seed I kept from last season, not the new ones from the agro-dealer, because this plot is for the family pot and I must watch my cash. I will not spray anything or use a water pump; we will wait for the vuli and masika rains and pull the weeds by hand. My wife and children will work here with me, so I expect we will spend about twelve days on this plot from the time we clear it until we finish harvesting. I will not hire outside labor for such a small plot.
